repair_description: amphora-assurance-capabilities/src/lib.rs: CroProtocolPackageV2::validate() Binding match arm now requires protocol_lock_sha256 == computed_protocol_lock_sha256() (new pub fn: SHA-256 over canonicalize(serde_json::to_value(&self.locked_numeric_thresholds)), the same stable_hash() construction candidate_sha256/formula_sha256 already use elsewhere in this struct) whenever locked_numeric_thresholds is non-empty. A format-valid-but-undereived hash (e.g. 'a'*64) now fails validate() with CroProtocolPackageError::Binding, which propagates through sign() and verify_signature() (both call validate() first).
theory_reference: Saltzer & Schroeder (1975) 'The Protection of Information in Computer Systems' Proceedings of the IEEE 63(9):1278-1308 -- complete mediation requires every field that participates in a trust decision to be independently authenticated. NIST FIPS 180-4 (2015) SHA-256 -- a hash is only a binding if the verifier recomputes and compares it against the bound content.
